question: In a certain code language, 'RETAINED' is written as 'ENIATERD' and 'MATURITY' is written as 'TIRUTAMY'. How will 'FIREWALL' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'RETAINED' is written as 'ENIATERD'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80ab3caacf90fd50ead19738d1e7a99f9a2a578945f17725a15724a5e93d8204.png] 

And,

'MATURITY' is written as 'TIRUTAMY'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed8d446cd02254239c6b4a3aaeee531cc0977c349e884e00bcd23848abf79dee.png] 

Similarly,

'FIREWALL' is written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06f132bb3954138385b9f40efb2a5f4fe9210916cb2febc69caa187fe3ffc51c.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
